title: Whistler back to Vancouver, via Capilano
summary: Sea-to-Sky drive south from Whistler, a four-minute detour to Capilano, then hand back the car.
drive: Whistler to North Vancouver to Vancouver · 2h 00m · 126 km

segments.name: Segment 1 — Whistler village, last morning
segments.blurb: Short walk before checkout, no gondola this late in the season.

stops.name: Whistler Village Stroll
stops.note: Pedestrian village, shops and coffee before departure.

expect.arrive: A last, easy morning in the pedestrian village before checkout; nothing to drive to yet.

paths.do: Walk the village stroll, coffee, browse before checkout.
Village stroll plus a short flat walk at Lost Lake.

segments.name: Segment 2 — Sea-to-Sky Highway south
segments.blurb: Scenic descent with optional falls, mine, and provincial park stops.

trail.from: Brandywine Falls Provincial Park parking lot
trail.caveat: Doubled from the 10–20 min one way that BC Parks publishes

stops.name: Murrin Provincial Park
stops.note: Small lake and cliffs, quick leg-stretch.

stops.name: Britannia Mine Museum
stops.note: Former copper mine, underground train tour.

stops.name: Porteau Cove
stops.note: Howe Sound viewpoint, popular photo stop.

expect.arrive: All four stops are direct highway pull-offs on Highway 99 heading south; Brandywine's lot is the biggest draw and can be tight, the others are small and quiet.
expect.parking: Brandywine Falls has a paved lot that can fill on weekends; Murrin, Porteau Cove, and Britannia Mine each have their own smaller dedicated lots.

paths.do: Stop for the falls viewpoint, skip the rest.
Brandywine Falls, a quick look at Murrin's lake, and the Porteau Cove viewpoint.
All of the above plus the underground train tour at Britannia Mine Museum.

segments.name: Segment 3 — Capilano Suspension Bridge
segments.blurb: Four-minute detour off the direct route into Vancouver.

map.to: Capilano Suspension Bridge Park, North Vancouver

stops.name: Cleveland Dam
stops.note: Nearby viewpoint over Capilano Lake, free.

expect.arrive: Capilano's own lot sits right at the entrance and is paid; it is one of the busiest attractions in the region and the lot does fill by mid-morning even off-season, with overflow shuttle parking used on busy days.
expect.parking: Paid lot at the entrance; fills by late morning most days, overflow lots run a shuttle when it does.

paths.do: Cross the main suspension bridge and back, skip Cliffwalk and Treetops.
Suspension bridge, Cliffwalk, and Treetops Adventure loops.

segments.cost: Capilano uses dynamic, timed-entry pricing set at checkout (capbridge.com/tickets-and-hours/, read 2026-09-12) rather than one published flat adult rate, and advance timed-entry booking is required — you pick a date and arrival window online. Third-party trip sites report 2026 adult prices roughly in the $65-80 CAD range, but only the date-specific checkout price is authoritative; do not treat that range as fixed. Fall hours: Sept 8-Oct 8, 9am-7pm; Oct 9-Nov 1 shifts to 10am-8pm for the Canyon Frights event (extended to 9pm on select nights).

segments.name: Segment 4 — Return car, settle into Mount Pleasant
segments.blurb: Drop the rental by 8pm, dinner near the Airbnb.

map.from: Capilano Suspension Bridge Park, North Vancouver

stops.name: Rental car return
stops.note: Must be back in Vancouver by 8:00pm — no car after this.

stops.name: Main Street, Mount Pleasant
stops.note: Dinner along Main St, walk from the Airbnb.

expect.arrive: Straightforward rental return at a downtown counter, then walking distance from the Mount Pleasant Airbnb to Main Street's restaurants.
expect.need: Rest of the afternoon and evening

paths.do: Return the car, taxi/rideshare to the Airbnb, rest before dinner.
Return the car, then walk Main Street for dinner and a browse.
